Ambura is a large continent. The northern border of Ambura is defined by the [[Borovian Mountains]]. Home to the [[Borovian Dwarves]], these mountains eventually blend into glaciers and a seemingly endless ice sheet. Nobody has crossed the ice sheet and returned.

Moving east, the Borovian mountains gradually slope down to the sea, eventually becoming underwater mountains. Many of these mountains rise above the surface of the sea. The seascape, peppered with islands, is known as the [[Peppered Coast]]. It is treacherous to navigate, and the islands are difficult to settle, so many of them are wild lands with no settlements. The eastern coast of Ambura is under the control of the [[Kingdom of Breland]] .

The southern portion of Ambura is defined by the [[Norsatch Promontory]], which pokes out into the [[Pearl Sea]]. The Promontory is home to the principality of [[St. Alberich]], a tiny independent land that is separated from the mainland by the [[Dragonback Mountains]], which run southwestward. The Dragonback mountains mark the southern border of Breland. 

The [[Sea of Grass]] marks the western border of Breland. While grasslands seem tame and docile, the Sea of Grass is a vast grassland choked with wild grasses that grow six to eight feet high. There are occasional oases or forested outcroppings, but in general it is extremely difficult to navigate. There are strange beasts and strange people in the grasses, and the grass-scape hides many small rivers, tributaries, and mud-holes. Apart from [[The Halflings of Bramblewood]] few people venture into the Sea of Grass, and it is widely considered to be a wasteland. 

The west coast of Ambura is a long, rocky, sandy beach. As the coastline crawls north, the beaches become gradually rockier, ending in taller cliffs as the coastline meets the western terminus of the Borovian Mountains. The Western Sea is rough and hearty, and is traversed by some trade vessels running merchandise to and from the Western Isles; it is a rough and hearty sea.
